newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end at 21.375 to 21.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end at 21.375 to 21.5 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates ended at 21.375 to 21.5 percent on Tuesday, little changed from Monday's close of 21.375 percent, and dealers said they expected more of the same over the next few days.

"We are at the beginning of the banks' two-week reserve period and with the alternative of the one-week repo repurchase facility at 21.5 percent, I don't expect rates to go any lower," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank.
